pmStartSessionProvider.description: Provider id. Leave it out to use the project's default provider when it is loaded, else the default provider for agents in Settings when it is loaded, else the first loaded provider in a fixed order, ready or not. Loaded providers when this list was made: `fake` (Fake (scripted)): ready; `claude` (Claude Code): not installed, fix: `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`; `codex` (Codex): not signed in, fix: `codex login`; `opencode` (OpenCode): not installed, fix: `npm install -g @opencode/cli`; `cursor` (Cursor): not installed, fix: `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash`; `gemini` (Gemini CLI): not installed, fix: `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`. An id that isn't loaded is refused while the runner is connected. Readiness isn't checked when a session starts: on a provider that isn't ready the session is created and then fails to start or fails its first turn, so pick one that is ready. The states are from the last check and may have changed since.
